_comment: YCH01 TWO-CELL FOLLOW-UP campaign for 05_full_matrix.sh -- a SEVENTH additive OpenWhisk campaign that is a targeted SIGN / STABILITY CHECK, NOT new coverage and NOT a seventh pooled performance estimator. It re-runs, under EXACT deterministic baseline-target position balance and STANDALONE handles ONLY, the ONLY two (workload,strategy) cells that -- after the sixth (portability_outlier_replication) balanced re-run refreshed the comparison table -- still have a POSITIVE workstation first-query effect but a NON-POSITIVE OpenWhisk one: YCh01/layers_5 (R_ws +0.025 neutral-positive, R_ow -0.243 from the sixth balanced batch) and YCh01/2f_top14 (R_ws +0.214, R_ow -0.019 near zero from the portability_ext batch). It tests only whether those two discrepancies are STABLE under a fresh independent batch with EXACTLY balanced within-pair position. The previously observed direction is described ONLY as a pair-position / short-lived execution-state / execution-storage-state effect; NO specific physical mechanism (e.g. page-cache carryover) is attributed, and the -0.019 2f_top14 value is a NEAR-ZERO result, NOT a strong harmful effect. Both cells are ALREADY members of the frozen 65-cell canonical portability matrix, so this campaign adds ZERO coverage (coverage stays 65/65) and reuses every existing plan/strategy/runtime byte-for-byte: 2f_top14 on native_ycsb_c_hot_hashed_01 reuses the audited portability_ext keyed plans (seeds 1,2,3; plan_sha256 6bc163bd.., seed-invariant top-14 selection); layers_5 reuses its committed static strategy artifact (5-interior prefix). The union of the two rectangular blocks (Y1-Y2) recomputes to EXACTLY 72 baseline-target pairs / 144 formal invocations under ONE portability_ych01_followup_run_config_sha256 (7a3cc45d..., independent of the byte-frozen primary 022fbeb0..., secondary 441609e6..., portability 64f44c3e..., portability_ext bf504a28..., portability_full_closure a5be8f15..., and portability_outlier_replication a564770a... campaigns), ONE schedule_seed (20260901), and ONE campaign fingerprint over the complete ordered 144-invocation schedule. baseline is the paired A-arm anchor in every block (not a target). position_balance=exact is a HARD GATE: the schedule builder assigns AB/BA order by a DETERMINISTIC per-cell/per-seed balanced hash-rank (NOT the per-pair coin-flip used by the prior campaigns), and the schedule validator asserts each cell is EXACTLY baseline_first==target_first -- 18/18 for YCh01/layers_5, 6/6 for each YCh01/2f_top14 seed. This campaign is STANDALONE ONLY (no warm arm) because the workstation<->OpenWhisk effectiveness comparison uses the standalone handle. It does NOT replace the original R_ow analysis values and does NOT alter the frozen 55-cell headline comparison; the prior batches and this one are reported side by side. Every block field is validated against the frozen runtime artifact pin (reused 2f_top14 keyed plans + reused layers_5 static strategy -- ZERO new keyed plans, ZERO new markers) before anything runs; real invocation still requires WS2_MATRIX_IMPL_READY=1 and happens on WK2, never WK1. Run this ONE matrix once: 05_full_matrix.sh --matrix ./matrix.portability_ych01_followup.json. Adding the two identity keys to the live manifest changes its bytes, so this campaign runs under a NEW image identity; the archived six prior campaign image identities are unaffected.
